scanNote:
Grammar Book'ning 5-nazorat testi (79-bet). Workbook'ning 5-nazorat testi ham AYNAN shu unitlarni (9-10) qamraydi.

⚠ KITOBDA BOSMA XATO: 8-bandda 'Amazon is in Brazil..' — gap oxirida IKKI NUQTA bosilgan. To'g'ri: bitta nuqta.

Bet burchagida QAYCHI belgisi (✂) bor — test qirqib olinadigan varaq.

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  B were        11  A is
   2  C Did         12  C made
   3  A couldn't    13  B weren't
   4  C go          14  A will
   5  A –           15  C didn't
   6  B graduated   16  B was
   7  C between     17  A have
   8  B The         18  A on
   9  B Was         19  C last
  10  C because     20  B didn't


MAVZULAR BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  PAST SIMPLE — 'BE' (Unit 9) —
     1, 9, 13, 16
  PAST SIMPLE — BOShQA FE'LLAR (Unit 10) —
     2, 4, 6, 12, 15, 17, 20
  'COULD/COULDN'T' (Unit 9) — 3
  ARTIKL (Unit 10) — 5, 8
  PREDLOG (Unit 3, 9) — 7, 18
  BOG'LOVChI (Unit 10) — 10
  'THERE IS/ARE' (Unit 3) — 11
  'WILL' (Unit 10) — 14
  VAQT KO'RSATKIChI (Unit 10) — 19


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA — 'DID' DAN KEYIN
ASOSIY ShAKL:

   2  'DID you SEE Lindsay yesterday?'
   4  'Where did they GO at Christmas?'
  15  'I DIDN'T HAVE a motorcycle.'
  17  'Did you HAVE a pet?'
  20  'I DIDN'T GO to school.'

  ⚠ Beshta bandda ham ASOSIY shakl:
     'did you SEE'  ✓  'did you SAW'  ✗
     'did they GO'  ✓  'did they WENT' ✗
     'didn't HAVE'  ✓  'didn't HAD'   ✗

  TASDIQDA esa 2-shakl:
   6  'He GRADUATED in 1998.'
  12  'My father MADE a dinner.'


⚠ 'BE' FE'LI 'DID' TALAB QILMAYDI:

   1  'Where WERE you born?'
      ('Where DID you be born?' — XATO!)
   9  'WAS Helen at the park?'
  13  'There WEREN'T any CDs.'
  16  'Charles Dickens WAS born.'

  ⚠ 'be' fe'lining o'zi savol va inkor
  yasaydi.


──── HAR BAND BO'YIChA ────

 1  'Where WERE you born?'
    'you' → WERE.
    ⚠ 'be born' — majhul nisbat.

 2  'DID you see Lindsay yesterday?'
    'yesterday' → Past Simple savoli.

 3  'Emily COULDN'T read when she was two,
     but she CAN read now.'
    ⚠ KALIT: ikkinchi qism 'she CAN read
    NOW' — hozir o'qiy oladi.
    Demak ilgari O'QIY OLMAGAN → COULDN'T.
    ('could' — mantiqan zid;
     'can't' — hozirgi zamon.)

 4  'Where did they GO at Christmas?'
    'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl.

 5  'He likes playing – BASKETBALL.'
    ⚠ SPORT bilan ARTIKL YO'Q!
       play football / basketball / tennis

    ⚠ CholG'U ASBOBI bilan 'THE':
       play THE guitar / THE piano

    (Workbook 1-nazorat testi, 2-mashq,
     9-band: 'I like playing THE guitar.')

 6  'He GRADUATED from university in 1998.'
    '1998' — aniq o'tmish → 2-shakl.
    ⚠ 'graduate FROM' — predlog 'from'.

 7  'The cinema is BETWEEN the café AND
     the post office.'
    ⚠ KALIT: 'AND' bor → ikki narsa
    ORASIDA → BETWEEN.

 8  'THE Amazon is in Brazil.'
    ⚠ DARYOLAR oldida DOIM 'THE'.
    (5-nazorat testi, Workbook 2-mashq,
     10-band ham shu edi!)

 9  'WAS Helen at the park on Sunday?'
    'Helen' — birlik → WAS.
    ⚠ 'Did Helen be...' — XATO.

10  'She went to the dentist BECAUSE she
     had toothache.'
    SABAB → BECAUSE.
    ('but' — qarama-qarshilik;
     'and' — qo'shish.)

11  'There IS a new museum.'
    'a museum' — BIRLIK → IS.
    ⚠ Bu HOZIRGI zamon (o'tmish emas!).

12  'My father MADE a delicious dinner
     LAST NIGHT.'
    'last night' → 2-shakl.
    make → MADE → made.

13  'There WEREN'T any CDs 100 years AGO.'
    'CDs' — KO'PLIK, o'tmish, inkor →
    WEREN'T.
    ⚠ Inkorda 'ANY'.
    ⚠ 'hadn't' — 'there' bilan
    ishlatilmaydi.

14  'I WILL finish it TOMORROW.'
    'tomorrow' → KELAJAK → WILL.

15  'I DIDN'T have a motorcycle when I was
     ten.'
    'when I WAS ten' — o'tmish → DIDN'T.
    ⚠ 'wasn't have' — XATO (ikki fe'l).
    ⚠ 'won't' — kelajak.

16  'Charles Dickens WAS born in
     Portsmouth.'
    Bir odam → WAS.
    ⚠ 'be born' — majhul nisbat
    ('had born' XATO).

17  'DID you HAVE a pet when you were
     young?'
    'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl → HAVE.

18  'My house is ON the corner of Pine
     Road AND Maple Avenue.'
    ⚠ 'ON the corner of X and Y' — turg'un
    birikma.
    ⚠ 7-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
    'BETWEEN' (ikki bino orasida), bu
    yerda 'ON the corner' (burchakda).

19  'He went to the cinema LAST Saturday.'
    ⚠ 'LAST' otdan OLDIN;
      'AGO' o'lchovdan KEYIN
      ('two days ago').
    'yesterday Saturday' — mantiqsiz.

20  'I DIDN'T go to school yesterday
     because I was ill.'
    'yesterday' → Past Simple inkor.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to graduate = bitirmoq (o'quv yurtini)
  a university = universitet
  a café      = kafe
  a post office = pochta bo'limi
  a dentist   = tish shifokori
  toothache   = tish og'rig'i
  a museum    = muzey
  delicious   = mazali
  a motorcycle = mototsikl
  a pet       = uy hayvoni
  ill         = kasal
  an avenue   = keng ko'cha

⚠ KITOBDA BOSMA XATO:

  8-bandda 'The Amazon is in Brazil..' —
  gap oxirida IKKI NUQTA bosilgan.

  ⚠ To'g'risi — bitta nuqta.

items.whyUz:
'you' → WERE.

⚠ 'be born' — MAJHUL nisbat, shuning uchun
'be' fe'li kerak.

⚠ 'Where DID you be born?' — XATO!
'be' fe'li 'did' talab qilmaydi.

items.textEn: 2  ................. you see Lindsay yesterday?
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YESTERDAY' → PAST SIMPLE savoli
→ DID.

⚠ Keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'did you SEE'
('did you SAW' XATO).

items.textEn: 3  Emily ................. read when she was two years old, but she can read now.
items.uz: Emili ikki yoshida o'qiy olmasdi, lekin hozir o'qiy oladi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: ikkinchi qism — 'but she CAN read
NOW'.

Demak ILGARI o'qiy OLMAGAN → COULDN'T.

'could' — mantiqan zid ('but' bilan
chiqmaydi);
'can't' — hozirgi zamon.

items.textEn: 4  Where did they ................. at Christmas?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'DID' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'did they GO'   ✓
  'did they WENT' ✗
  'did they GOES' ✗

items.textEn: 5  He likes playing ................. basketball.
items.whyUz:
⚠ SPORT bilan ARTIKL YO'Q:
  play football / basketball / tennis

⚠ CHOLG'U ASBOBI bilan 'THE':
  play THE guitar / THE piano

(Workbook 1-nazorat testi, 2-mashq, 9-band:
'I like playing THE guitar.')

items.textEn: 6  He ................. from university in 1998.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'IN 1998' — ANIQ o'tmish
→ PAST SIMPLE (2-shakl).

⚠ 'graduate FROM university' — predlog
'from'.

'will graduate' — kelajak;
'graduates' — doimiy odat.

items.textEn: 7  The cinema is ................. the café and the post office.
items.uz: Kinoteatr kafe bilan pochta bo'limi orasida.
items.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'AND' bor → IKKI narsa ORASIDA
→ BETWEEN.

'between A AND B' — turg'un qurilma.

⚠ 18-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
'ON the corner of X and Y'.

items.textEn: 8  ................. Amazon is in Brazil.
items.whyUz:
⚠ DARYOLAR oldida DOIM 'THE':
  THE Amazon, THE Nile, THE Thames

Yana 'the' bilan: okeanlar, tog' tizmalari,
cho'llar.

⚠ Workbook 5-nazorat testi, 2-mashq, 10-band
ham AYNAN shu edi!

⚠ Kitobda gap oxirida IKKI NUQTA bosilgan —
bosma xato.

items.textEn: 9  ................. Helen at the park on Sunday?
items.whyUz:
'Helen' — BIRLIK, o'tmish → WAS.

⚠ 'DID Helen be at the park?' — XATO!
'be' fe'li 'did' talab qilmaydi — o'zi savol
yasaydi.

items.textEn: 10  She went to the dentist ................. she had toothache.
items.uz: U tish shifokoriga bordi, chunki tishi og'riyotgan edi.
items.whyUz:
SABAB → BECAUSE.

[natija] BECAUSE [sabab]:
tish og'rig'i — SABAB, shifokorga borish —
NATIJA.

'but' — qarama-qarshilik;
'and' — qo'shish.

items.textEn: 11  There ................. a new museum in the city centre.
items.whyUz:
'A museum' — BIRLIK → IS.

⚠ DIQQAT: bu band HOZIRGI zamonda
('a NEW museum'), o'tmishda emas.

⚠ 13-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
'100 years AGO' → WEREN'T.

items.textEn: 12  My father ................. a delicious dinner last night.
items.uz: Dadam kecha kechqurun mazali ovqat tayyorladi.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST NIGHT' → PAST SIMPLE (2-shakl).

make → MADE → made.

'is making' — hozir;
'make' — 'My father' birlik, '-s' kerak
bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 13  There ................. any CDs 100 years ago.
items.uz: 100 yil oldin kompakt disklar yo'q edi.
items.whyUz:
'CDs' — KO'PLIK, o'tmish, INKOR → WEREN'T.

⚠ Inkorda 'ANY' ('some' XATO).
⚠ 'hadn't' — 'there' bilan ishlatilmaydi.

'100 years AGO' — Past Simple ko'rsatkichi.

items.textEn: 14  I ................. finish it tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'TOMORROW' → KELAJAK → WILL.

Keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'will FINISH'.

'do' / 'did' — hozirgi va o'tmish.

items.textEn: 15  I ................. have a motorcycle when I was ten.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'when I WAS ten' — o'tmish, inkor
→ DIDN'T.

⚠ 'wasn't have' — XATO (bir gapda ikki fe'l).
⚠ 'won't' — kelajak.

'didn't HAVE' — asosiy shakl.

items.textEn: 16  Charles Dickens ................. born in Portsmouth.
items.whyUz:
Bir odam → WAS.

⚠ 'be born' — MAJHUL nisbat:
  'He WAS BORN.'   ✓
  'He HAD born.'   ✗

1-band bilan bir xil qurilma.

items.textEn: 17  Did you ................. a pet when you were young?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'DID' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'Did you HAVE?'  ✓
  'Did you HAD?'   ✗
  'Did you HAS?'   ✗

2, 4, 15, 20-bandlar bilan bir xil qoida.

items.textEn: 18  My house is ................. the corner of Pine Road and Maple Avenue.
items.uz: Uyim Payn va Meypl ko'chalarining burchagida.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'ON the corner of X and Y' — TURG'UN
BIRIKMA.

⚠ 7-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
'BETWEEN the café and the post office'
(ikki bino ORASIDA).

Bu yerda BURCHAKDA → ON.

(Workbook 5-nazorat testi, 17-band ham shu.)

items.textEn: 19  He went to the cinema ................. Saturday.
items.whyUz:
⚠ O'RIN FARQI:
  LAST — otdan OLDIN ('LAST Saturday')
  AGO — o'lchovdan KEYIN ('two days AGO')

'yesterday Saturday' — mantiqsiz
(kecha ham, shanba ham bo'la olmaydi).

items.textEn: 20  I ................. go to school yesterday because I was ill.
items.uz: Kecha maktabga bormadim, chunki kasal edim.
items.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YESTERDAY' → PAST SIMPLE INKOR
→ DIDN'T.

Keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'didn't GO'.

'am not' / 'don't' — hozirgi zamon.

'because' — 10-band bilan bir xil bog'lovchi.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ 'DID' DAN KEYIN ASOSIY SHAKL — testda 5 marta

the Atlantic, the Alps, the Sahara

items.base: ON the corner of X and Y

patterns.exampleEn: Did you see Lindsay yesterday? I didn't go to school yesterday.
patterns.exampleUz: Kecha Lindsini ko'rdingizmi? Kecha maktabga bormadim.

patterns.formula: WHERE WAS/WERE + [ega] + BORN?  —  [ega] WAS BORN in [joy].
patterns.exampleEn: Where were you born? Charles Dickens was born in Portsmouth.
patterns.exampleUz: Qayerda tug'ilgansiz? Charlz Dikkens Portsmutda tug'ilgan.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'be born' — MAJHUL nisbat.
'Where DID you be born?' — XATO.

patterns.formula: [ega] COULDN'T + [ASOSIY fe'l] ..., but [ega] CAN + [ASOSIY fe'l] NOW.
patterns.exampleEn: Emily couldn't read when she was two, but she can read now.
patterns.exampleUz: Emili ikki yoshida o'qiy olmasdi, lekin hozir o'qiy oladi.

patterns.formula: [A] is BETWEEN [B] AND [C].   /   [A] is ON THE CORNER OF [B] AND [C].
patterns.exampleEn: The cinema is between the café and the post office. My house is on the corner of Pine Road and Maple Avenue.
patterns.exampleUz: Kinoteatr kafe bilan pochta orasida. Uyim Payn va Meypl ko'chalari burchagida.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ikkalasida ham 'AND' bor, lekin predlog
boshqa: BETWEEN (orasida) ↔ ON the corner
(burchagida).
